title: Indra Sawhney v. Union of India (Mandal Case)

content.caseIdentity: Indra Sawhney v. Union of India (Mandal Case), 1992 Supp (3) SCC 217
content.holding: 9-judge Bench upheld 27% OBC reservation; mandated Creamy Layer exclusion; fixed 50% quantitative ceiling; barred promotion reservations under Article 16(4).
content.relevance: Locus classicus on public employment reservations in India.

evidence.note: 9-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Writ Petition (Civil) No. 930 of 1990; 1992 INSC 267; 1992 Supp (3) SCC 217.
